name: NOTION
recent: Notion VTec 在2026财年第四季度恢复盈利，但全年仍录得净亏损。近期公告主要为执行主席 Thoo Chow Fah 的股权变动，包括行使 ESOS 期权、公开市场买卖及向子女转让股份。此外，公司因 ESOS 期权行使和凭单转换而发行新股。
notable: 执行主席 Thoo Chow Fah 在公开市场多次买卖公司股份，并行使 ESOS 期权获得新股。
公司因 ESOS 期权行使及凭单转换而发行新股，扩大股本。
公司2026财年第四季度恢复盈利，但全年仍录得净亏损。
risks: 执行主席 Thoo Chow Fah 向子女转让1,500,000股普通股。
earnings: 2026财年第四季度（截至6月30日）营收为1.0928亿令吉，环比增长2.5%，同比下滑4.5%；净亏损为480.7万令吉，净亏损率为4.4%，较上一季度的4.0%略有扩大。

recent_en: Notion VTec returned to profit in Q4 FY2026 but still recorded a net loss for the full year. Recent announcements mainly involve equity changes by Executive Chairman Thoo Chow Fah, including exercise of ESOS options, open market purchases and transfers to his children. The company also issued new shares from ESOS option exercises and warrant conversions.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Thoo Chow Fah traded shares in the open market multiple times and acquired new shares via ESOS option exercise.
The company issued new shares from ESOS option exercises and warrant conversions, enlarging its share capital.
The company returned to profit in Q4 FY2026 but still recorded a net loss for the full year.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Thoo Chow Fah transferred 1,500,000 ordinary shares to his children.
The company recorded a net loss for the full year.
earnings_en: For Q4 FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM109.28 million, up 2.5% QoQ but down 4.5% YoY; net loss was RM4.807 million with a net margin of -4.4%, slightly wider than -4.0% in the previous quarter.
